# ReliabilityOverheadTradeoff

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The explicit engineering tradeoff between packet delivery reliability (via redundancy) and the incurred bandwidth/latency overhead in stochastic routing. Central to designing neuromorphic-inspired routing controllers that must optimize resource allocation in real-time under uncertain network states.
